name: Scepter Gardens
introDiscord:
The royal gardens are overgrown but gorgeous.

Topiary crowns, decorative fountains, fruit beds, and Scepter Crabs now
occupy what used to be noble landscaping.
introTwitch:
The royal gardens are overgrown but gorgeous.

Topiary crowns, decorative fountains, fruit beds, and Scepter Crabs now
occupy what used to be noble landscaping.

scepter-gardens-approach.prompt: Scepter Gardens opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
One Berry grows beneath Shizuki's handwritten sign:

'ROYAL BERRY AGRICULTURE — ATTEMPT SEVEN.

THIS ONE LIVED!!!

DO NOT EAT.'

...awkward.

right.message: Star Candies rest inside a decorative garden urn.

forward.message:
A Scepter Crab emerges holding a broken garden ornament like an actual
scepter.

It has declared itself nobility.

scepter-gardens-depths.prompt: Deeper within Scepter Gardens, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
A Crab stands atop a tiny stone throne.

It raises its scepter.

Royal audience denied.

right.message:
A garden fountain contains restorative water.

Shizuki wrote:

'Plant watering fountain.

Also Shizuki watering fountain.

Dual purpose.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A hedge alcove hides a royal picnic coffer.

scepter-gardens-threshold.prompt: Near Scepter Conservatory, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A gardener's cabinet contains Star Candies and tiny pruning shears.

right.message: A Scepter Crab marches from beneath a crown-shaped hedge.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle rests beside Attempt Eight.

Attempt Eight is dead.

The note says:

'We do not discuss Attempt Eight.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Scepter Conservatory
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Inside Scepter Conservatory, dozens of Crabs line either side of a tiny
ceremonial path.

bossPromptDiscord:
Inside Scepter Conservatory, dozens of Crabs line either side of a tiny
ceremonial path.

At its end sits one Crab with an outrageously large scepter.

Use /yes to approach the royal gardener or /no to respect
crustacean sovereignty.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Scepter Conservatory. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Clawlord retreats into the conservatory.

One smaller Crab immediately sits on its throne.

Succession was swift.
